pages.title: Objects
pages.note: Immediate objects and object types are taught; subtyping with coercions and binary methods are only touched.

pages.title: Maps and Hash Tables
pages.note: Stdlib Map, Set and Hashtbl are taught and Core's Map is used; Core's comparator machinery, sets and hash tables are not taught in depth.

pages.title: Command-Line Parsing
pages.note: Core.Command flags and anonymous arguments are taught; sub-commands, choice parameters and interactive prompting are not.

pages.title: Concurrent Programming with Async
pages.note: Deferred, bind and Deferred.all are taught; pipes, readers and writers, ivars and TCP servers are not.

pages.title: Testing
pages.note: Expect tests and Alcotest are taught and property testing is built by hand; QuickCheck-style libraries and inline test frameworks are not used.

pages.title: Data Serialization with S-Expressions
pages.note: S-expressions and JSON are taught; XML and binary formats are not.

pages.title: The OCaml Platform
pages.note: Dune, opam, ocamlformat, odoc, Merlin and the toplevel are checked; utop and editor integrations are not machine-checked.

pages.title: Foreign Function Interface
pages.note: C stubs are taught; the ctypes library, which this chapter focuses on, is not.

pages.title: 8. Advanced examples with classes and modules
pages.note: Covers classes with modules in outline; the chapter's long worked examples are not reproduced.

pages.title: 9. Parallel programming
pages.note: Domains, atomics, Mutex and Condition are taught; Semaphore, deadlock analysis and the interaction with the garbage collector are not.

pages.title: 10. Memory model: The hard bits
pages.note: Data races and atomics are taught; the formal memory model (happens-before, litmus tests) is not.

pages.title: 11. The OCaml language
pages.note: The reference has many sections; lexical conventions, names, patterns, type definitions, classes, modules and compilation units are taught, but not every syntactic form.

pages.title: 12. Language extensions
pages.note: Does not yet cover lazy patterns, extended indexing operators, generalized open statements or every alert and syntax extension.

pages.title: 15. The runtime system (ocamlrun)
pages.note: OCAMLRUNPARAM and ocamlrun are exercised; the full parameter list and ocamlrun options are not.

pages.title: 17. Lexer and parser generators (ocamllex, ocamlyacc)
pages.note: ocamllex and Menhir are taught; ocamlyacc is not.

pages.title: 20. The debugger (ocamldebug)
pages.note: Backtraces are machine-checked; interactive ocamldebug sessions (breakpoints, stepping backwards) are described but not machine-checked.

pages.title: 21. Native debugging (gdb, lldb)
pages.note: Backtraces are machine-checked; interactive gdb or lldb sessions are not.

pages.title: 22. Profiling (ocamlprof, perf)
pages.note: ocamlcp and ocamlprof are checked; perf is Linux-only and was not run on this platform.

pages.title: 24. Optimisation with Flambda
pages.note: The validated switch reports flambda false, so only detection and the attributes accepted by every build are machine-checked.

pages.title: 25. Fuzzing with afl-fuzz
pages.note: The validated switch has no AFL support and no afl-fuzz binary; the workflow is described, not machine-checked.

pages.title: 28. Runtime detection of data races with ThreadSanitizer
pages.note: The validated switch was not built with ThreadSanitizer; the workflow is described, not machine-checked.

pages.title: 29. The core library
pages.note: Predefined exceptions are taught individually; the predefined types and the full list are not enumerated.

pages.title: 30. The standard library
pages.note: Roughly twenty of the standard modules are exercised; the rest are not.

pages.title: 32. The unix library: Unix system calls
33. The str library: regular expressions and string processing
36. The dynlink library: dynamic loading and linking of object files
37. Recently removed or moved libraries (Graphics, Bigarray, Num, LablTk)
pages.note: Lists libraries removed from or moved out of the distribution (Graphics, Num, Labltk); nothing to teach.
